_c_returnFromHiddenDelayInMilliseconds: How long to let the page settle after returning from a background tab before refreshing anything. GAM only requires 30s between requests, not 30s of viewability, so a burst on return is allowed - this is a short pause to let layout and scroll position settle, not a viewability guard.

fallbackSlotHeight._c: Assumed creative height in px for slots that report no size of their own (out-of-page, fluid). Keeps a collapsed slot sitting near the fold from passing the viewability test. Set to null to fall back to bare viewport intersection instead.

unfilledRefresh._c: Slots that keep coming back empty stop using the shorter `refreshUndeliveredInMilliseconds` gap after `limit` consecutive unfilled refreshes, and wait the full refresh interval instead. A viewable impression resets the count.

viewlessRefresh._c: Backs off slots that keep refreshing filled creatives without GPT ever reporting a viewable impression - typically obscured by a sticky header or overlay, which the geometric test cannot see. After `limit` such refreshes the slot's interval is multiplied by `backoff` until a viewable impression resets the count. Set to null to disable.
